018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.ipc;
019
020import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseTestingUtil;
021import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MediumTests;
022import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.RPCTests;
023import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
024import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
025import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
026import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
027
028@Tag(RPCTests.TAG)
029@Tag(MediumTests.TAG)
030public class TestSimpleRpcServer extends AbstractTestRpcServer {
031
032  @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
033  @BeforeAll
034  public static void setupClass() throws Exception {
035    // Reuse TEST_UTIL if the test already initialized it.
036    if (TEST_UTIL == null) {
037      TEST_UTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
038    }
039    // Set RPC server impl to SimpleRpcServer
040    TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration().set(RpcServerFactory.CUSTOM_RPC_SERVER_IMPL_CONF_KEY,
041      SimpleRpcServer.class.getName());
042    TEST_UTIL.startMiniCluster();
043  }
044
045  @AfterAll
046  public static void tearDownClass() throws Exception {
047    if (TEST_UTIL != null) {
048      TEST_UTIL.shutdownMiniCluster();
049    }
050  }
051
052  @Test
053  public void testSimpleRpcServer() throws Exception {
054    doTest(tableName);
055  }
056}
